title: [Pre Order, PS5] Marvel's Wolverine $0 When You Trade in 2 Selected PS5, Xbox Series X or Nintendo Switch 2 Games @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: [Pre Order, PS5] Marvel's Wolverine $0 When You Trade in 2 Selected PS5, Xbox Series X or Nintendo Switch 2 Games @ JB Hi-Fi

[justtoreply] Not a great deal considering most or all of those are triple a games. Not much different to selling them on marketplace or eBay and waiting for wolverine to drop in price
[matictac] I personally did the EB deal, trade two $10 minimum value games and get Wolverine for $50. I just grabbed two games off marketplace for $10 each.
[matictac] Ah right, yeah that makes it a bit hard to swallow.
The hack would be to buy four $10 games on marketplace, do two EB trade deals, cancel one and move the credit over to Wolverine.
[wonderboy] That doesn't work anymore. They'll give you the regular trade in value if you cancel.
[matictac] @wonderboy: Ah okay, I returned the last game I did trade deal for and got the full value back, so I figured it'd work the same. I guess add an extra step. 😛
[Hmad9800] How to know if the games are $10 min trade value? I'm assuming 3 years old won't be 10?
[freoleo] They have a trade checker nowadays
https://www.ebgames.com.au/trade
[matictac] Tons of old PS4 games worth at least $10, God of War, Last of Us, Black Ops 3 & 4, Need for Speed, Crash Bandicoot.
I just searched PS4 on Marketplace within a few KMs of me and checked the values on the EB site and there was a load of games I could grab for $10 each that met the criteria.
[hnxhyz] No. Eb only accept ps5, Switch and x box x game for trade in for new pre order game.
No ps4 game
[Fredfloresjr] Ripoff, nothing beats the infinite bigw $10 newsletter.
[blitzn] Is this game similar gameplay to spiderman?
[virtualds] Hopefully some discount just before the release day. Guessing $79 or $89
